task: N2.10 source frontend and bounded consumer condition IR v2
research_goal: Differentiate public-consumer search witness, actual reached branch checks before/after writes and early exits. Later architecture-provider qualification/identity/deadline matching remains separate; no automatic Linux contract claim from ordinary-C success.
registration: Before v2 implementation and new independent challenge disclosure. N2.9 nine known sources/2754 reference rows are development-only. Preserve all v1 methods, oracles and failed outcomes.

scope.frontend: Complete ordinary-C int function. Audit scanner replaces comments with same-length whitespace preserving each character coordinate/newline and original SHA; preserve parsing-view SHA and mapping. Strings/char escapes distinguish comment markers, not deleted; reject directives, backslash-newline splice, unterminated comment/string/char, unsupported GNU. No statement/macro/GNU/asm deletion or hand-rewritten Linux projection.
scope.data: Bounded scalar int parameters/locals, const read-only scalars, fixed local 1D int arrays size1..16; initialized known values, explicit conservative arithmetic and dynamic index checks. Block-scoped integer aliases with explicit no-shadowing admission is allowed; if scope unsupported reject. No pointers/globals/calls/alias effects.
scope.control: Canonical bounded for index=0; index<literal or local immutable limit0..16; increment. Search optional pure alias declarations/assignments and if-continue, final if(predicate){witness=value;break;}, following no-witness if-return with sentinel exit. Optional singleton/early return. One second loop with up to one conditional/unconditional array write and up to one check per reached iteration, before or after write. Pure continue guards may reduce reached domain. Check either direct if-return or monotonic scalar flag init0, only conditional set1, followed by if(flag) return and tail return; no resets, arbitrary accumulator or unproved effect deletion.
scope.semantics: Preserve first matching witness, guard after search, actual check ordering, local declarations per loop iteration, writes and scalar lifetimes. Check predicate neutral (not semantic failure); arbitrary return values do not prove bug/normal. Empty/not-reached check domains distinct. Unknown/OOB/uninitialized/unsupported effects remain insufficient.
scope.api: analyze_consumer(document) from exact raw id/path/revision/text; evaluate_consumer(analysis,parameters dict) returns status/return_value/trace. No expected predicate/roles/oracle input. Expose ordered check_observations, each iteration (canonical second-loop ordinal), predicate_value (if guard), and writes_before (actual second-loop array writes during that iteration before guard). No native observation claim for fields only generated by Python reference.
scope.linux: Replay unchanged existing D05/D10 only; unsupported valid. If GNU still blocks, document compiler-backed frontend feasibility as next plan; do not spend indefinite scope on toys or expand helper tree.

roles.n2_selector: Implementation v2 module/tests; only known N2.9 development inputs, no new hidden oracle until freeze
roles.arch_check_review: New independent source+Python reference, compile exact admitted positive sources and compare native C return; do not read v2 code/tests/output before source/expected freeze. Expected check_observations from separately written Python are labeled as reference-only. Challenge sources hidden from implementation until method freeze.
roles.authority_audit: Scope/frontend/IR review and pre-freeze corrections, post-freeze independent attribution
roles.root: Scope/source/expected freeze, execute comparisons and unchanged Linux replay, meaningful reporting and notes

evaluation.developer: Meaningful lexical, semantic, scope, unsupported and known-case regression. Do not count tests as defects. Record implementation fixes before challenge freeze separately.
evaluation.independent: Fresh source forms within stated scope: comments/CRLF/renaming/zero-or-one domains/first-hit/partial-witness/check-before-vs-after/continue/direct-vs-flag, plus scope negatives. Bounded varied inputs and independently written Python/native return comparison. Report source coverage and actual evaluated records, then return and check-observation agreement; zero comparisons not success.
evaluation.freeze: Freeze source+expected independently and method+tests+adapters before result disclosure; no post-outcome fixes or sanitized input retries to chase pass. Old known cases cannot be independent again.
evaluation.claims: Component challenge independence only, not unseen Linux or human expert gold. Native C return cross-check distinguished from Python expected trace. Formal Linux independent positive/normal stays0/0 without new qualified cases.

exit: Prototype, audited frontend, development regression, fresh frozen challenge, unchanged Linux replay, scope review and Windows/WSL notes; report remaining failures honestly.
